# Pool ball impact audition sources — 2026-11-12

These are four different field/Foley recordings of ball-to-ball collisions,
downloaded from their authors' official Freesound high-quality MP3 previews.
The user selected candidate A on 2026-11-12. Its production derivative is
../ball-clack-a.wav; see the parent LICENSE.md for its retained attribution.
B/C/D remain audition candidates only.

The MP3s are unmodified source previews. The audition page creates mono WAV
derivatives: principal-contact extraction, maximum 90/75/65/65 ms respectively,
0.2 ms fade-in and 15 ms fade-out, short-window level matching with a 0.7 peak
ceiling. It does not resample pitch or synthesize substitute impacts. Downloaded
WAVs repeat the isolated hit three times with silent gaps for comparison.

Attribution for A and its derivatives: “Billiard balls single hit-dry.wav” by
juskiddink, Freesound sound 108615, licensed under Creative Commons Attribution
4.0. Edited as described above for the Flight Party / JoyFlock audition. Retain
this credit and license link if this candidate is adopted or redistributed.

The current-sound reference uses the existing Za-Games 539854 recording; see
the parent LICENSE.md. Listening quality and the final choice are pending user
review for the merged rack sound; A's single-impact selection is confirmed.
Source descriptions and license links were verified on 2026-11-12.
